title: Verify: Type-check config unit tests
summary: Unit tests prove tsconfig and package.json declare Node types
description: Test that tsconfig.json types includes node and package.json lists @types/node, so the tsc gate is satisfied.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts tsconfig types contains node, vite/client and vitest/globals
technical_constraints: Reads files from disk only; no network or child processes

steps.action: Create the file; read tsconfig.json and package.json with readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), ...)) and JSON.parse. Add test 'tsconfig types include node' asserting compilerOptions.types toEqual expect.arrayContaining(['node','vite/client','vitest/globals']), and test 'package declares @types/node' asserting devDependencies['@types/node'] is defined.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/typecheck.test.ts
